tldr: Mars through the 12th house brings focus to rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat.
body: Mars transiting the 12th house energizes rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports private healing and release: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or escape, isolation, or avoiding what needs care.
advice: Aim the fire in the 12th house deliberately. Work with rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
